page_title: NAP 2-2 ROM | Napoli v AS Roma 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Simone Sozza has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) launches a cross from the corner, but Mile Svilar is alert to thwart the effort.
90+4' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is caught offside!
90+3' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Victor Osimhen (Napoli) who loops his header high over the bar.
90+3' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+2' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The referee signals a corner kick to Napoli.

90+2' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Mile Svilar has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

89' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Simone Sozza signals that the goal stands! The AS Roma players celebrate. GOAL! The corner comes over and Evan Ndicka wins a simple header before Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) nods the ball into the back of the net. 2:2.
89' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Simone Sozza is going to take a look using VAR.
89' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
88' AS Roma have a corner.
88' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Leo Ostigard.
88' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
86' Here is a change. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is going off and Francesco Calzona gives the last tactical orders to Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rasmus Kristensen leaves the pitch and Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) comes on.
84' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
84' 2 - 1 Goal! Victor Osimhen (Napoli) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Mile Svilar to commit before slotting the penalty into the right of the goal.
83' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is going to take the penalty!
82' The Napoli players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
81' There's a break in play and referee Simone Sozza must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Napoli using VAR. This could be interesting!
81' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Frank Anguissa (Napoli) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
78' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
76' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
75' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
75' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
74' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
73' Mile Svilar pulls off a great save to deny Victor Osimhen (Napoli) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
72' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
71' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
69' Substitution. Matteo Politano leaves the pitch and is replaced by Cyril Ngonge (Napoli).
69' It will be a substitution. Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) is ready to enter the pitch as Jens Cajuste walks off.
69' Daniele De Rossi prepares a substitution. Sardar Azmoun is replaced by Tammy Abraham (AS Roma).
69' It is time for a substitution. Renato Sanches (AS Roma) is on for Edoardo Bove.
69' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.

67' That was a nice football moment. Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Alex Meret guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!

66' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) has a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better as his effort ends wide of the left post.
65' 1 - 1 Goal! Jens Cajuste passes the ball to Mathias Olivera (Napoli) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Mile Svilar couldn't do anything about it. 1:1.
62' Simone Sozza couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Frank Anguissa (Napoli) and blew his whistle.
61' Stephan El Shaarawy will be replaced by Angelino (AS Roma).
59' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Alex Meret no chance!
59' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
59' Referee Simone Sozza is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to AS Roma!
58' Celebrations by AS Roma are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
58' Dangerous play by Juan Jesus (Napoli). Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to AS Roma! Let's see who will take responsibility.
57' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
56' Half-chance! Victor Osimhen (Napoli) plays a pass into the box, but Mile Svilar reacts well to snuff out the attack.
55' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards goal, but Alex Meret makes a magnificent save!
55' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) commits a rough foul. Simone Sozza stops the game and makes a call.
54' AS Roma keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.

51' Matteo Politano (Napoli) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
50' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) latches on to a precise cross and hammers the ball goalwards, but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
50' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
49' The referee blows his whistle as Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was too aggressive in his challenge.
48' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Simone Sozza blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went wide of the left by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
44' It looks like Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) saw red with that tackle. Simone Sozza won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
43' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
43' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
41' The game is interrupted as Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is flagged offside.
40' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is about to take a corner kick.
40' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Mile Svilar makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
39' The corner from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is intercepted by Mile Svilar.
38' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
38' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
37' A lofted pass to the edge of the six-yard box is won in the air by Victor Osimhen (Napoli), but his tame header goes well wide of the left post.

36' A fine solo run by Frank Anguissa (Napoli) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
35' Half-chance! Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) plays a pass into the box, but Alex Meret reacts well to snuff out the attack.
34' The current number of corner kicks is 2:1.
32' Simone Sozza has a clear sight and sees a foul from Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli).
31' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) gets in a good position to shoot just outside the box after a nice pass, but his effort is unintentionally blocked by one of his teammate.
30' A fine pass finds Victor Osimhen (Napoli) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Mile Svilar reacts superbly to deny him.
29' Matteo Politano (Napoli) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Simone Sozza who sees an offensive foul.
28' A pass lands at the feet of Victor Osimhen (Napoli) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
27' Napoli are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
24' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
24' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Simone Sozza blows for a foul.
22' 6:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
20' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
20' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
18' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Mile Svilar is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
18' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
18' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
17' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Simone Sozza no option but to blow his whistle.
16' Juan Jesus (Napoli) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
15' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
14' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
11' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' Referee Simone Sozza sees the trip by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
11' Matteo Politano (Napoli) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
10' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
9' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Mile Svilar comes off his line to gather the ball.
7' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
7' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Victor Osimhen (Napoli) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
6' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
6' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) towers above the defence but fails to trouble the keeper, heading the corner kick well wide of the left post from close range.
6' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner.

6' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
3' Simone Sozza blows for a foul after Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
2' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Simone Sozza will officiate today.
